name: supervillain-scrapers
description: Apify actors for lead scraping — a generic crawler, an Instagram e-mail scraper, and a Google Maps / OpenStreetMap lead finder.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix apify-actor install && npm --prefix instagram-email-scraper install && npm --prefix google-leads-scraper install
scripts.test: npm run check:shared && npm --prefix apify-actor test && npm --prefix instagram-email-scraper test && npm --prefix google-leads-scraper test
